'''Cosmic dust''' were dust particles in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that came from condensed [[Star/Legends|star]] matter. [[Shield camouflage]] often made use of this dust near [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] to aid in stealth. [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|The Cloak of the Sith]], which surrounded the planet [[Roon/Legends|Roon]], was a huge dust cloud.
